## Decisions
- Drops overwrite by default (Ctrl/Cmd inserts), matching Premiere — this is a deliberate behavior change from the old bin-drop-stacks-overlap behavior, called out in FEATURES.md and the docs page.
- A drag still brings the un-patched companion stream along (only `,`/`.` respect un-patching) — noted as a deliberate deviation from a literal reading of the phase-4 spec, recorded in the phase-4 shipped-note in `plan/features/three-point-editing.md`.
- `EditableTrack<T>` made `public static` on `ClipPlacement` rather than duplicated, since paste (`PasteAtPlayhead`) and the new drop path both need "first editable track of a kind."
- Kept `Border.dragHandle` (not `Button`) for the video/audio-only drag handles because a `Button`'s press would swallow the pointer-drag gesture — same reasoning as `MediaBrowserPanel.EnableDrag`'s existing pattern.
